field.label: Appearance
field.help: Follow the operating system preference or force a light or dark appearance.

field.label: Accent color (light)
field.help: Six-digit hexadecimal color used for actions, links and selection in light mode.

field.label: Accent color (dark)
field.help: Six-digit hexadecimal color used for actions, links and selection in dark mode.

field.label: Mica surface (light)
field.help: Base color for navigation, cards, dialogs and flyouts.

field.label: Surface opacity (%)
field.help: Allowed range: 60–100. Reduced-transparency preferences still take precedence.

field.label: Page title prefix
field.help: Optional text placed before the original OPNsense browser title.

field.label: Logo path
field.help: Optional same-origin web path, for example /ui/themes/opnfluent/build/images/company-logo.svg.

field.label: Favicon path
field.help: Optional same-origin web path to a PNG, SVG or ICO file.

field.label: Hide footer
field.help: Hide the footer on both the login page and authenticated administration pages.

field.label: Custom CSS
field.help: Optional CSS appended after the theme styles. Use carefully; invalid rules can affect the administration interface.
